title: Suggestion Workbench: sandboxed safe-apply timeline and reversible audit trail
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Ship a 'Suggestion Workbench' experience in Optimize that lets customers inspect batching/caching recommendations, preview the exact config diffs, run them in a sandboxed dry-run, and apply/revert changes with a clear, queryable audit trail.

Scope: recommendation cards with expanded inspector (cost/latency delta, sample trace), compact diff preview pane (human-readable YAML + tokenized change view), a sandbox runner that executes changes against a staging routing policy and returns simulated SLO/cost metrics, and an immutable apply history with reversible actions and metadata (actor, rationale, link to eval).

Success metrics: adoption by >30% of active optimize users for first-time safe-applies, 40% reduction in support tickets about unexpected performance regressions after apply, and presence of diff + sandbox sign-off in 85% of applied changes.

UX constraints: keep primary recommendation card compact on first glance (title, primary delta, urgency), push details to inspector flyout; preview must be copy/paste-friendly and include both 'effective config' and 'rollback clue' lines. The sandbox should clearly label that changes are non-production and include links to a synthetic workload runner used for regressions.

Rollout plan: staged rollout behind feature flag for 10% of orgs -> 50% -> 100% across 3 weeks. Telemetry events instrumented for each card open, preview generated, sandbox run, apply attempted, apply succeeded, revert attempted.

Open questions: how to represent multi-change rollups (batched vs atomic), whether sandbox runs should consume dedicated evaluation capacity, and how to surface ML-quality regressions from the sandbox vs production.

Related artifacts: design spec (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPT/Suggestion+Workbench, Figma mock: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/suggestion-workbench, evaluation harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize-evals/pull/112
acceptance_criteria:
1) Recommendation cards render summary and open inspector with full cost/latency deltas and sample traces.
2) Diff preview shows both before/after config (YAML) and a line-level change navigator.
3) Sandbox run executes a dry-run policy and returns simulated metrics and a downloadable run log.
4) Apply flow records an immutable history entry with actor, timestamp, diff snapshot, sandbox run id (if present), and a one-click revert that reinstates the previous config and creates a follow-up history entry.
5) Audit UI allows filtering history by actor, model, route, and date range and provides export as CSV.
